name: Exp_ColorBulls
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorBulls custom indicator, which uses a two-stage smoothing system to detect momentum shifts. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from neutral to bullish (color change to 2) and sell positions when it transitions from bullish to neutral (color change to 0), with separate controls for entry and exit on each side.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorBulls自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用两级平滑系统来检测动量变化。当指标从中性转为看涨（颜色变为2）时开多仓，从看涨转为中性（颜色变为0）时开空仓，并可分别控制多空方向的入场和出场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于ColorBulls指标的颜色变化来捕捉动量转换点。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区从0变为2时触发买入信号，当从2变为0时触发卖出信号，这实际上是在捕捉动量从无到有和从有到无的转折点。出场条件与入场信号对称：买入信号触发时同时平空仓，卖出信号触发时同时平多仓，形成反转式出场机制。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举实现，支持按自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的保证金或固定手数等多种模式计算仓位大小。资金管理方面，EA使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数处理下单逻辑，并设有止损和止盈参数（默认分别为1000和2000点），偏差控制为10点。策略使用了两层平滑算法（第一层和第二层分别可配置不同平滑方法和周期），通过SignalBar参数可选择信号触发所在的K线索引，默认使用前一根K线以避免重绘。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on detecting momentum shifts via color changes in the ColorBulls indicator, which applies a two-stage smoothing process to price data. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the indicator buffer transitions from 0 (neutral) to 2 (bullish), and a sell signal is triggered when it transitions from 2 (bullish) to 0 (neutral), effectively capturing momentum inflection points. Exit conditions are symmetric with entries: when a buy signal fires, existing sell positions are closed, and when a sell signal fires, existing buy positions are closed, creating a reversal-style exit mechanism. Position sizing is handled through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting multiple modes including percentage of free margin, balance, margin after losses, or fixed lot size. Money management leverages the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions for order placement, with configurable stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), plus a slippage deviation control of 10 points. The strategy employs two smoothing layers (each configurable with different smoothing methods and periods from SMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA), and the SignalBar parameter allows selecting which bar index triggers signals, defaulting to the previous bar to avoid repainting issues.

pros: 双平滑系统有效减少虚假信号，提高信号质量
多空方向可独立控制入场和出场，灵活性高
支持多种资金管理模式和9种平滑算法，适应性强
pros_en: Two-stage smoothing system effectively reduces false signals and improves signal quality
Independent control for buy/sell entry and exit provides high flexibility
Supports multiple money management modes and 9 smoothing algorithms for strong adaptability
cons: 缺乏扩展点差过滤，在流动性差的市场中滑点可能导致意外亏损
指标颜色变化信号存在滞后性，两级平滑进一步增加了延迟
止损1000点止盈2000点的固定值未考虑市场波动率变化，可能不适配所有品种
cons_en: No spread filter, which can lead to unexpected losses in low-liquidity markets with wide spreads
Indicator color change signals are inherently lagging, and the two-stage smoothing adds further delay
Fixed SL/TP values of 1000/2000 points do not account for market volatility changes across instruments
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，使风险参数自适应市场波动率
添加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在不利条件下开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit to make risk parameters adaptive to market volatility
Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 缺乏点差过滤，高波动时段滑点风险较大
固定止损止盈不适应不同市场波动环境
依赖自定义指标ColorBulls，若指标文件缺失EA将无法运行
risk_points_en: No spread filter creates significant slippage risk during high-volatility periods
Fixed stop loss/take profit does not adapt to different market volatility environments
Dependency on the custom ColorBulls indicator means the EA fails if the indicator file is missing
